description: Validate LaTeX syntax and ChkTeX rules in <300ms via POST /v1/lint ($0.002 USDC via x402) without rendering a PDF. Use this before tex402_compile to catch errors quickly at 1/4th the cost.

engine.description: TeX engine for draft validation ('pdflatex' or 'xelatex', default 'pdflatex')

files.description: Optional map of relative project paths (e.g. 'refs.bib', 'macros.sty') to UTF-8 strings or 'base64:...' payloads

files_from_disk.description: Optional map of target relative path in the TeX project -> local file path inside TEX402_ALLOWED_ROOT (or cwd) to read and attach

main_tex.description: Root LaTeX document source code (.tex) to lint and validate

name: tex402_lint
title: TeX402 Fast LaTeX Lint ($0.002 USDC)
